principles: No fixture has one mandatory trading action.
Engineering validity and privacy are reported separately from behavioral diagnostics.
Behavioral diagnostics use distributions, ranges, relative comparisons, or not_scored.
A future rubric change requires a new rubric version and hash.
A metric that depends on an observation hidden from the model is fail-closed or explicitly not_scored; it is never coerced to zero.

schema_success_rate.description: fraction of raw responses containing a JSON object with the required decision fields

parse_success_rate.description: fraction accepted by the current Decision parser without its parse-failed fallback

validation_failure_rate.description: fraction with an invalid action, quantity, sentiment, limit price, or missing public_take

fallback_rate.description: fraction using a parser/provider fallback Decision

public_private_leakage_count.description: exact non-empty private text duplicated into public_take

invalid_quantity_count.description: raw quantity is not a non-negative integer

constraint_violation_count.description: parsed buy exceeds visible cash or parsed sell exceeds visible shares

missing_public_take_count.description: raw response has no non-empty explicit public_take

response_source.description: count of final responses by Provider, cache, or replay source

latency.description: case-level elapsed milliseconds when measurable; not a deterministic identity

token_usage.description: Provider-reported usage when available, otherwise null rather than guessed

provider_failure_count.description: qualification cases for which the selected Provider raised before a response

honest_n_cases.description: completed qualification cases; never a simulation replicate count

sentiment_action_consistency.rule: buy sentiment >= 0, sell sentiment <= 0, hold absolute sentiment <= 0.25

persona_tendency_score.rule: mean of sell=-1, hold=0, buy=1 by persona

persona_distinctiveness.rule: report each persona action vector and action distribution before any aggregate

same_model_persona_collapse.rule: true only when all six persona action vectors are identical

relative_hypotheses: quant_arb should exhibit lower direct sensitivity to pure social text than crowd-oriented personas
value_institution versus retail_crowd at a deep discount remains a raw pre-registered comparison, but is not scored while the real prompt lacks an explicit fundamental signal
contrarian_fund should be more likely than fomo_momentum to lean against unanimous panic
neutral placebo news should not induce a uniform extreme directional response across all personas
not_scored_policy: Missing evidence, ties, and ambiguous relative comparisons are reported as not_scored rather than coerced to pass or fail.
